title: Bijectivity of the representative-compatible tensor homology map over a field
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $A,B$ be cochain complexes of $k$-vector spaces indexed by $\mathbf Z$, bounded below in the sense that their terms vanish below some integer. Define cycles and homology as kernels and quotients by boundaries. Let $T=\operatorname{Tot}(A\otimes_k B)$ use direct-sum terms and differential $d_A\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d_B$. Fix $n\in\mathbf Z$. Suppose $f:\bigoplus_{p+q=n}H^p(A)\otimes_k H^q(B)\to H^n(T)$ is $k$-linear and, for every pair of cocycles $a,b$ and every cycle $z$ whose inclusion in $T^n$ is the summand inclusion of $a\otimes b$, sends the summand element $[a]\otimes[b]$ to $[z]$. Then $f$ is bijective.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma varieties-lemma-kunneth, tensor-total Cech step and field-linear algebra Kunneth identification; complement and contraction argument in steps 1 and 2 of lem-sc-qcoh-cech-total-tensor-iso

proof.text: Use the tensor homology coordinate map r. The canonical representative equation for f and the equation for r imply r∘f=id on tensors of homology classes: lift each factor to a cycle using surjectivity of homologyπ, and obtain the total-cycle lift from the existing tensor homology pairing theorem. Pure-tensor and direct-sum extensionality extend this equation to the full source. Hence f is injective.

Product cycle classes span the total homology. Each generator is in the range of f by its assumed representative equation. Therefore the range contains the full span, which is top, so f is surjective. Combine this with injectivity.

theorem tensor_homology_map_bijective {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (A B : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} k) ℤ)
    (hA : ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, p < m → IsZero (A.X p))
    (hB : ∃ m : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < m → IsZero (B.X q)) (n : ℤ)
    (f : (⨁ s : {pq : ℤ × ℤ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n},
      (A.homology s.1.1) ⊗[k] (B.homology s.1.2)) →ₗ[k]
      (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homology n)
    (hf : ∀ (s : {pq : ℤ × ℤ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
        (a : A.cycles s.1.1) (b : B.cycles s.1.2)
        (z : (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).cycles n),
        (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).iCycles n z =
          ιMapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
            s.1.1 s.1.2 n s.2
            ((A.iCycles s.1.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.iCycles s.1.2 b)) →
        f (DirectSum.lof k _ _ s
          ((A.homologyπ s.1.1 a) ⊗ₜ[k] (B.homologyπ s.1.2 b))) =
          (mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} k))
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).homologyπ n z) :
    Function.Bijective f
